summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K containing a routine Stock Exchange announcement dated 01 October 2026 titled Total Voting Rights. As at 30 September 2026, issued share capital comprised 24,328,991,329 ordinary shares of US$0.20 20/21, of which 1,161,734,604 are held in Treasury, giving total voting rights of 23,167,256,725. The disclosure, made under FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 5.6.1R, merely provides the denominator for shareholder interest notifications and states it is not an offer. No special-situation event, terms, advisor or recommendation is present.
